leads.summary: The new restart-only exit masks rfkill errors, including a readout error that previously failed the command
leads.consequence: With a successful service restart but failed rfkill list, the command now exits 0 instead of the pre-PR nonzero status; the floating-terminal presenter therefore displays Done despite a failed status read. If rfkill unblock fails, the restart can succeed while the radio remains blocked and still report success (the unblock omission also existed on the base).
leads.triage: already in Opus final (O1); corroborated; not published (negligible, reachable only when /dev/rfkill is unavailable; head code equals earlier review's suggestion)

leads.summary: Open PR #13085 also rewrites the restart command and the two heads conflict
leads.consequence: Both cannot be merged unchanged. The pinned merge produces a content conflict in the command; resolving it by keeping #13101's shorter script leaves #13085's newly added test for btusb recovery without the modprobe calls it asserts, so that test fails. This is a coordination conflict with a separate open PR, not proof of a defect in #13101 alone.
leads.triage: factual; verified by coordinator (gh pr view/diff, git merge-file of blobs: 2 conflict regions, coord/) and by Opus self-check; published as Related open PR note

prior_findings.claim: A failed restart still ends in "Done!": exit status came from the final rfkill list, so a refused sudo or failed systemctl restart exited 0 and the menu wrapper printed Done!; CLI callers also saw success.
prior_findings.reason: edeb1332 saves the restart status and exits with it after the readout. Stubbed runs: head exits 0/1/1/5 for success/sudo refusal/systemctl 1/systemctl 5 (prior 0 in all); real launcher + omarchy-show-done on a pty prints Failed (exit code N)! for the failures, Done! only on success; CLI path execs the script (bin/omarchy:993). New test passes on head, fails against the prior script. Sol hunter independently observed matching propagation (exit 11 and 23).

prior_findings.claim: Script always calls sudo but lacked # omarchy:requires-sudo=true, so omarchy commands --json reported requires_sudo: false.
prior_findings.reason: Marker at bin/omarchy-restart-bluetooth:4; sandboxed omarchy commands --json reports requires_sudo: true at head (false at base and prior head); omarchy commands --check passes.

A three-way git merge-file of base, #13101 head and #13085 head reports 2 conflict regions in the script. Coordination note, not a defect in #13101.

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up at `edeb1332` to the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13101#issuecomment-5825489383) and the [author's reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13101#issuecomment-5825678984). Both earlier suggestions are **resolved**, and no new issue was found in the changed code.

### Resolved: a failed restart no longer ends in "Done!"

**Verified:** the script now saves the `sudo systemctl restart` status and exits with it after the `rfkill list bluetooth` readout, which still runs in every case. Stubbed runs through the real floating-terminal launcher and `omarchy-show-done`:

```text
stub outcome                   previous head 1b656c4b     current head edeb1332
all succeed                    exit 0, Done!              exit 0, Done!
sudo refuses (exit 1)          exit 0, Done!              exit 1, Failed (exit code 1)!
systemctl restart fails (1)    exit 0, Done!              exit 1, Failed (exit code 1)!
systemctl restart fails (5)    exit 0, Done!              exit 5, Failed (exit code 5)!
```

`omarchy restart bluetooth` hands off to the script with `exec`, so CLI callers get the same status. The new failing-`systemctl` test case passes on this head and fails against the previous script.

### Resolved: `requires-sudo` metadata

**Verified:** `# omarchy:requires-sudo=true` is in the header, and `omarchy commands --json` now reports `requires_sudo: true` for this command (`false` at the previous head). `omarchy commands --check` passes.

The statements marked Verified in the earlier review still hold at this head. The full `test/shell.d/bluetooth-test.sh`, including its Node section, now passes in the sandbox.

**Related open PR:** #13085 also targets #13078 by adding a `bluetooth.service` restart to `bin/omarchy-restart-bluetooth`, plus a fallback `btusb` reload for #12519. Both PRs start from the same base and change the same lines of that script, and a three-way merge of the two heads conflicts in two places. #13085 also adds its own restart test, so whichever lands second will need both its script and its tests reconciled with the other.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of the new commit, the script, its menu and CLI invocation paths, the command metadata and the test file. Shell behavior, the repository test and the command metadata ran in an isolated sandbox with stubbed `rfkill`, `sudo`, `systemctl` and terminal-launch helpers, against the previous and current heads. #13085 was compared by a text merge only. Real `sudo`, systemd, BlueZ, Bluetooth hardware and the desktop were not exercised. Recovery of a desynced adapter still rests on the report in #13078.

**AI process:** Fresh follow-up review: Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
